blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) personnel recovered 93 assorted pieces of unexploded ordnance, including a massive 500-pound World War II-era aerial bomb, at a junk shop in Barangay Alat, Jolo, Sulu on Monday. The retrieval operation was launched after authorities received reports regarding the discovery of heavily corroded explosive materials stored inside the commercial establishment. Responding to the scene, personnel from the Coast Guard Station (CGS) Western Sulu, led by its chief, Cmdr. Al-Hafidz Bi, with the CGK9-EOD Team Western Sulu and the Coast Guard Special Operations Unit Sulu, established safety perimeters and conducted an initial […]...
